issues.legal_issue: An agreement to accept a specified acquisition payment by a stated deadline and make no further claim for the acquired land can relinquish a claim to statutory interest when the agreement, read as a whole, shows that the payment settled all claims.
material_facts: The dispute arose from a claim for interest on compensation for acquired land, and the matter reached the Supreme Court in an appeal from an order allowing a writ petition.
While compensation proceedings were pending, the landholders agreed to accept a reduced, specified acquisition payment, provided it was paid by a stated deadline.
The government’s letter asked the landholders to agree to make no further claim for the acquired land.
The landholders said delay in payment had caused hardship and that immediate payment was an essential part of their agreement.
In the signed agreement, the landholders agreed to make no further claim in regard to compensation if actual payment was received by the deadline.
The specified payment was made before the deadline, and the agreement did not expressly reserve a right to claim interest.
issues.conclusion: The agreement covered the landholders’ claim to interest as well as the principal compensation. They were not entitled to further interest; the appeal was allowed and the writ petition was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 23 and 34 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, interest is payable when compensation is not paid or deposited by the time possession is taken. But the scope of a settlement is determined from its language and context. Here, the phrase concerning no further claim for compensation was used comprehensively to settle claims relating to the acquisition; the condition requiring payment by the deadline showed that the landholders accepted the specified sum in full satisfaction and relinquished future interest claims. Had they intended to preserve an interest claim, they could have expressly reserved it. The judgment cites no earlier cases.

rule.if: land_acquisition_interest_dispute and appeal_from_writ_order and specified_settlement_payment and no_further_claim_agreed and payment_deadline_met and no_interest_right_reserved

predicates.land_acquisition_interest_dispute: The proceeding concerns a claim for interest on compensation for acquired land.
predicates.appeal_from_writ_order: The matter is an appeal from an order allowing a writ petition about the interest claim.
predicates.specified_settlement_payment: The landholders agreed to accept a specified acquisition payment on the stated condition that it be paid by a deadline.
predicates.no_further_claim_agreed: The landholders agreed that they would make no further claim relating to the acquired land or its compensation.
predicates.payment_deadline_met: The agreed payment was made by the deadline set in the settlement.
predicates.no_interest_right_reserved: The settlement did not expressly preserve a right to claim interest.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerns interest on compensation for acquired land, a settlement of further claims for a specified payment is performed by the agreed deadline, and no interest right is reserved, the further interest claim is barred.
